incident_description: Treasury reports that several high-value cross-border payments are absent from the downstream settlement dashboard, although core payment processing completed.

hypotheses.statement: Downstream publication failed after successful payment processing.
A schema deployment introduced an incompatible attribute mapping.

agent_decisions.reason: The affected population and lifecycle divergence must be established first.

agent_decisions.objective: Inspect FX enrichment for affected payments.
agent_decisions.reason: Payment processing completed, but downstream publication depends on completed conversion.

agent_decisions.objective: Confirm whether required exchange rates existed.
agent_decisions.reason: Rate availability must be eliminated before concluding that payment attributes caused the failure.
FX evidence shows missing enrichment input, so downstream validation outcomes must be inspected.

agent_decisions.objective: Correlate the failure with recent changes.
agent_decisions.reason: The consistent missing attribute suggests a producer schema or mapping regression.

evidence.title: Affected payment population identified
evidence.summary: Thirty-seven high-value cross-border payments were processed successfully but were not published to downstream settlement reporting.

evidence.title: FX enrichment was not completed
evidence.summary: All affected payments were missing the source-currency attribute required by the FX conversion service.

evidence.title: Required exchange rates were available
evidence.summary: Valid rates existed for every required currency pair during the incident window.

evidence.title: Publication records failed mandatory validation
evidence.summary: The downstream publication control rejected all affected records because sourceCurrency was null.

evidence.title: Failures began immediately after schema deployment
evidence.summary: Payment producer version 4.8 renamed sourceCurrency to instructedCurrency, but the downstream mapping continued reading the previous attribute.

root_cause.title: Schema mapping regression blocked FX enrichment
root_cause.explanation: Producer version 4.8 renamed sourceCurrency to instructedCurrency. The downstream mapping continued reading sourceCurrency, causing null enrichment input and rejection by the publication quality control.

recommendations.title: Restore the compatible field mapping
recommendations.description: Map instructedCurrency to the downstream source-currency contract and replay the affected payment population.

recommendations.title: Add schema compatibility validation
recommendations.description: Validate producer schema changes against downstream required mappings before deployment.

executive_summary: Thirty-seven high-value cross-border payments worth USD 182.45 million were missing from settlement reporting.
The payments completed core processing but failed downstream FX enrichment and publication.
A schema rename introduced in producer version 4.8 was not reflected in the downstream mapping.

capability_opportunity.title: Schema Compatibility Guardian
capability_opportunity.problem_detected: Schema changes can be deployed without validating downstream field dependencies.
capability_opportunity.proposed_capability: Automatically compare producer schema changes with registered downstream mappings before deployment.
capability_opportunity.expected_benefit: Prevent mapping regressions and identify affected consumers before production release.
